process_diagnostics.reading_rule: Time integrals sample both Heun stages at growth substeps. They are split-step diagnostics, not exact residence integrals. Demand and supply fields are extensive kg in the represented layer. Disabled growth has zero demand and supply; occupancy remains measured. Event counts are actual per-layer increments.

result.evidence: Continuous-mass finite-volume particle calculation with inherited geometry, drag, sticking, chipping and liquid-saturated growth. Collision events are exact at fixed layer properties; volume, vertical mixing, split-time, fractional-fragment allocation and sampling errors remain distinct. No observed-storm calibration or giant-aggregate survival law.
result.reading_rule: The final null diameter means +infinity and retains all arrivals. Moment arrays are unnormalized cumulative extensive quantities per square metre. Quantiles are per realization. Fractional fragments retain water and number in local allocation remainders, participate after allocation of a whole particle, and are bounded separately; no fragment water is discarded. The demand bound excludes delayed-allocation feedback. Physical tail predictions require convergence and suitable geometry, fracture and cloud exposure.

criterion: Refinement screen: mean mass-CDF change <=0.05 and mean flux/d50/d90/d99 changes <=5%. These are practical thresholds, not sampling confidence bounds.

interventions.no_deposition: Vapour growth disabled; collisions, chipping, injection and settling retained.
interventions.no_aggregation: All encounters disabled, including collision-generated chipping; vapour growth retained.
interventions.no_chipping: Sticking retained; nonsticking encounters cause no mass loss or fragment production.
interventions.full_dt30: All processes, half macrostep at the middle volume.

evidence: Numerical process-removal experiments and passive accounting under the same prescribed lunar forcing. Removal changes the evolving particle state and does not isolate an additive contribution. Empty and under-demand supply losses account for instantaneous unused capacity, not a counterfactual prediction after restoring that water.
reading_rule: Whole realizations provide standard errors. Each trace has filling and four gathering blocks, then layers ordered from freezing level upward. Demand uses both Heun-stage quadrature weights; occupancy and limitation are substep observations. No tail deletion, physical cutoff, empirically calibrated fracture or storm optical forecast.
